messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the RBAC rename deploy yesterday a couple tenants started failing KMS access during deprovision. Seeing 403s from the provisioner. cc @sam @jenna :eyes:

sam: Can you paste the exact log line?

maria: 
```
2026-02-19T01:15:03Z ERROR provisioner: deprov tenant=tenant-37 op=kms-revoke err=AccessDenied
details="principal mismatch: expected=redwood:tenant:extid=alice@example.com actual=redwood:tenant:extid=4f8a3c2b-uuid"
stack=provisioner/kms.go:214
```

jenna: That smells like the extID->principal naming changed in the RBAC refactor (we switched to stable identity_id). KMS grants were created against the old principal name, so revoke tries to use a principal that no longer maps -> no-op.

kyle: So revoke didn't remove the grant, and the tenant's new principal doesn't match the grant -> access lost (but grant still exists). Is that right?

maria: Exactly. Repro is easy locally: when the provisioner uses the new mapping it generates `redwood:tenant:extid=<uuid>` principals; the KMS grants in CloudTrail show `redwood:tenant:extid=<email>` for creations earlier in Feb.

sam: Do we have a list of impacted keys/tenants? We need to scope blast radius before any mutation.

maria: I queried the provisioner logs and CloudTrail; quick numbers: 14 tenants with failed revoke in last 48h, 9 have already reported errors in the app layer. I kicked off a read-only reconcile job.

jenna: Important: any fix that mutates KMS grants must be auditable and approved. We should produce a candidate action list (rebinds) and run a patch during maintenance. No unilateral key edits.

maria: Agreed. Reconcile job output (read-only) snippet:
```
- tenant-12: candidate_rebind old_principal=redwood:tenant:extid=alice@example.com new_principal=redwood:tenant:extid=4f8a3c2b-uuid key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/aa11
- tenant-37: candidate_rebind old_principal=redwood:tenant:extid=bob@example.com new_principal=redwood:tenant:extid=7b9c2d-uuid key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/bb22
```

provisioner-bot: provisioner-reconcile-job/1723456789 STARTED by maria :gear:

provisioner-bot: provisioner-reconcile-job/1723456789 FINISHED: 14 tenants scanned, 12 candidate rebinds identified, 0 auto-applied (read-only) :white_check_mark:

kyle: Next steps proposal:
- produce ticket with full candidate list and CloudTrail evidence per tenant
- get approval from security/compliance (jenna)
- schedule a maintenance window to apply rebinds with an operator-run, logged script
- add a safe fallback that maps old principal names to new ones for 7 days after a rename

sam: I can own the operator-run script and the playbook. I'll assemble CloudTrail links and the table of candidates.

jenna: Please include audit IDs for each grant create event. We'll need that for compliance. Also add a post-mortem checklist to avoid future rename-induced drift.

maria: I'll paste the reconcile job artifacts into the ticket (read-only csv + CloudTrail links). Planning to include a snippet of the mapping change that caused this:
```
- OLD: principal_name = fmt("redwood:tenant:extid=%s", user_email)
- NEW: principal_name = fmt("redwood:tenant:extid=%s", identity_id)
```

kyle: Also add a short-term mitigation: have the provisioner accept either principal namespace when computing access so tenants don't immediately lose access during rollouts. That should be opt-in and timeboxed.

provisioner-bot: action required: create ticket ENGSEC-2026 with reconcile artifacts (maria)

maria: OK creating ENGSEC-2026 now and linking this thread. I'll tag @jenna/sam when it's ready. Thanks all — I'll update once the candidate list is reviewed and the change window is scheduled. :thumbsup:
